title: which prusik runs is decided by accident: hooks use PATH, drive children use cwd shadowing, role specs use PATH
detail: observed-writes (2026-11-16): bare 'prusik drive' ran the 0.245.0 wheel (PATH) while drive's children ran 'sys.executable -m prusik' with cwd=root, which in the engine repo imports the working-tree source; one drive mixed two versions, and the wheel's role parser escalated 'plan names no builder role' after the source was fixed. The class: (1) hook commands in templates/.claude/settings.json are bare 'prusik gate ...', resolved via PATH at fire time (an activated venv, a project dependency or a stale pipx install wins; preflight probes once at install); (2) drive.py:106/109 and overhead.py:159 spawn 'sys.executable -m prusik' with cwd=project root, so any prusik/ package there shadows the installed one; (3) ~70 bare 'prusik ...' instructions in role specs resolve via each agent's PATH. Fix shape: one explicitly resolved launcher every hook, child and agent instruction goes through, a version check that fails closed on mismatch, nothing that depends on cwd or PATH order; settings.json is committed, so no machine-absolute path in it. Operator: 'we should avoid by accident mechanics, as prusik needs to be reliable for adopters.'

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_pinned_engine.py
